faq_heading: Langley condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Langley condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 357 of 768, or 46%. A further 379 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Langley?
faq.a: $509,450 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $435,000 and $590,000.

faq.q: Which Langley area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Aldergrove Langley, at $432,500 across 31 sales at $545 a square foot, median year built 2025. The highest of the 7 lowest was Fort Langley at $800,000.

faq.q: How fast do Langley condos sell?
faq.a: 27 days at the median, closing at 97.3% of the last list price, with 5% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).
In Langley, 357 of the 768 condos (46%) sold under $600,000. The median was $509,450, with the middle half between $435,000 and $590,000. The busiest price range, $600,000 to $799,999, had 379 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Langley

In Aldergrove Langley the median condo sold for $432,500 across 31 sales, $167,500 under $600,000. Across Langley the median condo took 27 days to sell and closed at 97.3% of the last list price, with 5% of the 768 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
